description: Source code for ztest POSIX implementation in Zephyr, including test filtering, listing, and execution control functions.

methods.name: add_test_filter_option
methods.description: Adds command line options for test filtering and listing.

methods.name: ztest_relative_filename
methods.description: Shortens filename by removing current directory for readability.

methods.name: ztest_set_list_test
methods.description: Sets the global flag for listing tests.

methods.name: z_ztest_get_list_test
methods.description: Returns whether tests are being listed.

methods.name: ztest_get_test_args
methods.description: Returns the command line test arguments.

methods.name: z_ztest_run_all
methods.description: Runs or lists all registered unit tests based on command line arguments.

methods.name: z_ztest_testargs_contains
methods.description: Checks if test arguments contain specific suite/test names.

methods.name: z_ztest_should_test_run
methods.description: Determines if a test should run based on command line arguments.

methods.name: z_ztest_should_suite_run
methods.description: Determines if a test suite should run based on command line arguments.
